promptBlocks.label: SEEDANCE 2.5 · MULTI-REFERENCE VIDEO PROMPT — VERBATIM
promptBlocks.text:
FORMAT: 30s / 16:9 / romantic cinematic couple film / soft rhythmic cuts driven by rack-focus transitions and motion-blur passes, dreamy flowing pace
STYLE: 35mm analog film aesthetic matching @Image 3: fine grain, soft pastel grade, creamy halation, muted greens and warm skin tones, golden late-afternoon Aegean light, gentle handheld sway, shallow depth of field as the storytelling tool, romantic realism, one visual identity, no style mixing.
REFERENCES:
@Image 1 defines the couple's identities: preserve both faces exactly. HIM: curly dark brown hair, light beard, black square-framed wayfarer sunglasses, thin silver chain, the same cream resort shirt with botanical embroidery, now with relaxed beige linen trousers and tan espadrilles. HER: dark chin-length bob under a white patterned headscarf tied at the nape, white angular cat-eye sunglasses, small red hoop earrings. Both keep sunglasses on in every shot.
@Image 2 defines HER outfit exactly as she appears: sleeveless blue denim mini dress with raw hem, beige suede espadrilles, delicate bracelets. No handbag. This styling is identical in every shot.
@Image 3 defines the car, field and film texture: a white classic air-cooled sports coupe with a low rear spoiler, front trunk lid open and overflowing with a lush arrangement of orange, yellow, cream and red wildflowers, parked in a tall green meadow dotted with wildflowers. Match this exact car, arrangement and analog texture.
@Image 4 defines the backdrop ONLY: the hilltop acropolis of Lindos, ancient stone walls and columns above a cascade of white cube houses and dry Aegean slopes, deep-blue sea beyond. It sits softly hazed in the far background of every wide shot; use it as scenery only.
VIDEO PROMPT:
[Shot 1 — 0–2.5s, hook] Extreme close-up through blurred foreground wildflowers in the breeze; rack focus pulls slowly from the petals to the white coupe, its open trunk glowing with flowers, the acropolis a warm silhouette in the haze. End state: car sharp, petals blurred.
[Shot 2 — 2.5–5s] Cut. Close-up on the trunk flowers; rack focus drifts past the blooms to the couple far behind in the bokeh, running toward camera through tall grass, laughing. End state: couple sharpening, growing in frame.
[Shot 3 — 5–8s] Cut. Low fast tracking through the grass, heavy natural motion blur: she runs ahead, headscarf tails streaming, glancing back with a laugh; he chases two steps behind, linen trousers rippling, grass whipping past the lens. End state: her hand almost caught.
[Shot 4 — 8–10.5s] Cut. He catches her hand mid-stride; momentum swings them into one playful spin, grass seeds and petals lifting in the golden backlight, motion blur streaking the meadow. End state: spin settling, foreheads close.
[Shot 5 — 10.5–13s] Cut. Still macro: her white cat-eye lenses fill the frame, his smiling reflection mirrored in both lenses, background melting to golden bokeh. Focus racks from the reflection to her soft smile. End state: her smile sharp.
[Shot 6 — 13–15.5s] Cut. He jogs to the open trunk and picks one perfect orange-gold bloom with a soft stem snap; a few loose petals drift off. End state: bloom raised, trunk still full.
[Shot 7 — 15.5–19s] Cut. Slow dolly push-in, waist to close: he gently tucks the bloom under the edge of her headscarf above her ear; her hand rises to hold it; both laugh quietly, the acropolis glowing in the haze between their shoulders. End state: flower seated, her fingers on it.
[Shot 8 — 19–21.5s] Cut. He lowers the trunk lid with care to a soft vintage click; they split around the car, both doors open, they drop into the seats, twin door thunks. Sunglasses on. End state: both seated, smiling at each other.
[Shot 9 — 21.5–24s] Cut. Through-windshield two-shot, warm reflections sliding over the glass: he drives relaxed, one hand on the thin wheel; she leans toward him laughing, then stretches her arm out the window, fingers surfing the wind. End state: her hand riding the wind.
[Shot 10 — 24–27s] Cut. Side tracking with soft motion blur at wheel height: the coupe rolls along a narrow dirt track through the meadow, tall grass brushing the sills, wildflowers streaking past the lens. End state: car easing right toward the valley.
[Final shot — 27–30s] Cut. Static wide: the coupe recedes down the winding track toward the white houses and the acropolis hill, a faint golden dust ribbon behind it, sea glinting beyond. One last rack focus from a sharp foreground wildflower to the tiny distant car. Hold the final frame 0.8s.
AUDIO: (Intimate minimalist neoclassical score, warm felt piano with soft organic-electronic swells, entering on the first rack focus, breathing with the cuts, lifting gently when the flower is given, settling into a tender sustained chord over the final wide.) <ASMR-grade close-mic foreground: grass swishing against legs, soft footfalls on meadow soil, linen and denim fabric movement, her light laugh and his low chuckle, one delicate stem snap, petals brushing, the trunk lid's soft click, twin door thunks, a gentle air-cooled engine settling to a warm burble, tires rolling on dry earth.> <Background ambience: meadow breeze, cicadas, distant gulls, faint sea wash.> No dialogue, no voiceover, no subtitles.
CONSISTENCY: The same two people as @Image 1 in every shot, identical faces, hair and skin tones; his black wayfarers and her white cat-eyes never removed; the orange-gold bloom stays at her headscarf from Shot 7 to the end. Identical outfits throughout. Exactly one white classic coupe, same flower arrangement. Same meadow and light direction, the acropolis always in the same far background position; screen direction left to right in the chase and drive.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: no removed sunglasses, no altered identities, no outfit changes, no handbag, no second car, no other people, no traffic, no plate text, no on-screen text or logos, no drone shots, no style mixing, no CGI look, no warped hands, no distorted car, no crushed flowers, no dialogue.

references.label: @Image 1 — the identity lock: both faces exactly, his embroidered resort shirt, her scarf, cat-eyes — and the denim dress that @Image 2's outfit clause pins in place.
@Image 3 — the hero prop: one white classic coupe, a front trunk overflowing with wildflowers, tall meadow — and the 35mm grain the whole film is graded to.
@Image 4 — the backdrop ONLY: the Lindos acropolis above its cascade of white cube houses, allowed into every wide shot as hazed scenery and nothing more.

tutorialHtml:
DENIZ AKKABAK · SEEDANCE 2.5 TUTORIAL · @DENIZ.AKKABAK

MADE IN INVIDEO · invideo.io/i/DENIZ-ig

The Lindos Bloom

Three photos, one prompt — and a thirty-second Aegean love film with a trunk full of wildflowers.

A TUTORIAL BY DENIZ AKKABAK · @DENIZ.AKKABAK

PIPELINE SEEDANCE 2.5 · MULTI-REFERENCE FORMAT 30S · 16:9 · 35MM GENRE ROMANTIC COUPLE FILM

One golden-hour selfie, one flower-stuffed classic coupe, one Greek hillside — that is the entire production budget of this film. Everything else is direction. The trick is not the model; it is the discipline of the prompt: every reference is handed exactly one job, every shot is handed exactly one destination, and the humble rack focus — cinema's oldest way of saying look here now — is promoted to editor. Seedance 2.5 reads the images, the eleven timecoded shots and the sound design as one contract, and returns twenty-eight seconds of romance that never breaks character.

STEP 01 — SEEDANCE 2.5

One Prompt, Eleven Shots

Seedance 2.5's multi-reference mode maps your attachments to @Image numbers in the order you add them — so the order is part of the prompt. The REFERENCES block then splits the world into locked roles: the identities (@Image 1), her styling (@Image 2 — the same sleeveless denim mini dress she is already wearing in the identity shot, spelled out so it survives every cut), the car-meadow-film-texture package (@Image 3), and a backdrop that is permitted to be scenery only (@Image 4). With the nouns pinned down, the VIDEO PROMPT is free to behave like a real shot list: eleven numbered setups, each with a timecode, a camera move, and an end state.

REFERENCE INPUTS — ATTACH IN THIS ORDER

OUTPUT

STEP 02

Anatomy — Why the Film Holds Together

Eleven shots, two faces, one car and a fixed hill are a lot of promises for a single generation. Each block of the prompt exists to keep one of them:

  1. 01

    The contract

    FORMAT is signed before a single frame exists: 30 seconds, 16:9 — and, crucially, “soft rhythmic cuts driven by rack-focus transitions and motion-blur passes.” The edit style is declared as part of the format, so every shot is generated already knowing how it will be joined to the next.

  2. 02

    One film stock, no exceptions

    STYLE outsources the entire look to a reference — “35mm analog film aesthetic matching @Image 3” — then names its ingredients: fine grain, creamy halation, muted greens, golden late-afternoon Aegean light. The closing clause, “one visual identity, no style mixing,” is the anti-drift bolt that keeps eleven shots on the same emulsion.

  3. 03

    One reference, one job

    The REFERENCES block is a caste system: @Image 1 owns the faces, @Image 2 owns her outfit, @Image 3 owns the car, field and texture, and @Image 4 “defines the backdrop ONLY … use it as scenery only.” That capitalized ONLY is the strongest fence in the prompt — it keeps the acropolis from wandering out of the haze and into the foreground.

  4. 04

    Every shot has a destination

    All ten cut shots close with an explicit landing — “End state: car sharp, petals blurred,” “End state: her hand almost caught.” Motion prompts drift when movement is open-ended; here every 2–3 second clip knows exactly what its final frame must contain.

  5. 05

    Rack focus is the editor

    The transitions are written as optics, not cuts: petals to coupe in Shot 1, blooms to the running couple in Shot 2, his reflection to her smile in Shot 5, one last wildflower to the tiny distant car in the finale. The focus pull is the film's grammar — which is why the FORMAT line promised it up front.

  6. 06

    Sound is choreography

    AUDIO is scored to the picture — the felt piano enters “on the first rack focus” and lifts “when the flower is given” — while the ASMR inventory (one delicate stem snap, the trunk lid's soft click, twin door thunks) doubles as an event list the model can synchronize to.

  7. 07

    The insurance

    Every clause of the NEGATIVE PROMPT cancels a known failure mode: “no removed sunglasses” protects the identity trick, “no second car” and “no other people” guard the private meadow, “no drone shots” keeps the camera human, and “no CGI look” defends the 35mm contract to the last frame.

THE RESULT

Output — Twenty-Eight Seconds of Golden Hour

Audit the film against the CONSISTENCY block, clause by clause: the wayfarers and cat-eyes never leave their faces, the orange-gold bloom holds its place at her headscarf from Shot 7 to the last frame, there is exactly one white coupe and one flower arrangement, the acropolis stays pinned to the same hazy corner of every wide — and the chase and the drive both flow left to right, precisely as ordered.

THREE PHOTOS. ONE PROMPT. NO CREW.

Direct the focus, and the story follows.

Swap the meadow for a midnight boulevard, the coupe for a wooden sailboat, Lindos for your own skyline — the skeleton carries any romance. Lock the identities, give every reference a single job, cut on the focus, and tell the model where each shot must land.
